prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of households with internet access in five countries in 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Some people believe that university education should be free for all students. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

The line graph below shows the percentage of people in five age groups who used the internet in 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

The pie charts below show the sources of energy used by households in a country in 2000 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

The table below shows the average number of hours worked per week in five countries in 2010 and 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

The diagram below shows how waste paper is recycled. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. [Sample diagram description: Used paper is first collected from homes and offices and taken to a recycling plant. There, it is sorted to remove plastic and other waste, then mixed with water and chemicals to form pulp. The pulp is cleaned, dried and pressed into large rolls. Finally, the rolls are cut into sheets and sent to shops and offices as new paper.]

The maps below show the centre of a small town in 2000 and today. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words. [Sample map description: In 2000, the town centre had a market square in the middle, a library on the north side, a car park in the south-east and a row of small shops along the main street. Today, the market square has been replaced by a shopping centre, the library has moved to the east side, the car park has become a bus station, and a new park has been built in the south-west.]

The bar chart below shows the number of visitors (in millions) to a coastal city in 2023, by region of origin. The line graph below shows the total number of visitors (in millions) to the city from 2019 to 2023: 2019: 6.4, 2020: 2.1, 2021: 3.0, 2022: 5.8, 2023: 8.1. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Some people think that online learning is as effective as learning in a classroom, while others believe that face-to-face learning is better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

Traffic congestion is becoming a serious problem in many large cities. What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

More and more people are now working from home instead of going to an office. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

Social media has become a very important part of young people's lives. Why do young people spend so much time on social media? What effects does this have on them? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
